// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto from puerto.toml — never hand-edit. The snapshot follows the entity's
// fields; add an event with `puerto generate event Customer <name>`.
use puerto_core::DomainEvent;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use uuid::Uuid;

use super::model::Customer;

pub const CUSTOMER_CREATED: &str = "customer_created";
pub const CUSTOMER_UPDATED: &str = "customer_updated";
pub const CUSTOMER_DELETED: &str = "customer_deleted";

/// What every customer event carries: the customer as the API shows it — primitives, value
/// objects unwrapped. A public contract: consumers decode it with
/// `envelope.decode::<CustomerSnapshot>()`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CustomerSnapshot {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub email: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
}

impl CustomerSnapshot {
    pub fn from_entity(entity: &Customer) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: entity.id.value(),
            email: entity.email.value().to_string(),
            name: entity.name.clone(),
            tags: entity
                .tags
                .iter()
                .map(|v| v.value().to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        }
    }
}

/// What happened to a customer. Its write use cases record one through their unit of work.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum CustomerEvent {
    Created(CustomerSnapshot),
    Updated(CustomerSnapshot),
    Deleted(CustomerSnapshot),
}

impl CustomerEvent {
    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> &CustomerSnapshot {
        match self {
            Self::Created(snapshot) | Self::Updated(snapshot) | Self::Deleted(snapshot) => snapshot,
        }
    }
}

impl DomainEvent for CustomerEvent {
    fn event_type(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Created(_) => CUSTOMER_CREATED,
            Self::Updated(_) => CUSTOMER_UPDATED,
            Self::Deleted(_) => CUSTOMER_DELETED,
        }
    }

    fn aggregate_type(&self) -> &'static str {
        "customer"
    }

    fn aggregate_id(&self) -> Uuid {
        self.snapshot().id
    }

    fn schema_version(&self) -> u16 {
        1
    }

    fn payload(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        // A snapshot holds primitives only: serialising it cannot fail.
        serde_json::to_value(self.snapshot()).unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::tests::mothers::customer_mother::CustomerMother;

    #[test]
    fn should_describe_every_event_when_one_is_recorded() {
        // Arrange
        let entity = CustomerMother::random();
        let snapshot = CustomerSnapshot::from_entity(&entity);
        let events = [
            (CustomerEvent::Created(snapshot.clone()), "customer_created"),
            (CustomerEvent::Updated(snapshot.clone()), "customer_updated"),
            (CustomerEvent::Deleted(snapshot.clone()), "customer_deleted"),
        ];

        for (event, event_type) in events {
            // Act + Assert
            assert_eq!(event.event_type(), event_type);
            assert_eq!(event.aggregate_type(), "customer");
            assert_eq!(event.aggregate_id(), entity.id.value());
            assert_eq!(event.schema_version(), 1);
            assert_eq!(event.snapshot(), &snapshot);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn should_keep_the_json_contract_when_the_snapshot_is_serialised() {
        // Arrange
        let snapshot = CustomerSnapshot::from_entity(&CustomerMother::random());

        // Act
        let payload = CustomerEvent::Created(snapshot.clone()).payload();

        // Assert — a renamed or removed key breaks every consumer of these events.
        let mut keys: Vec<&str> = payload
            .as_object()
            .map(|object| object.keys().map(String::as_str).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        keys.sort_unstable();
        assert_eq!(keys, ["email", "id", "name", "tags"]);
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<CustomerSnapshot>(payload).ok(),
            Some(snapshot)
        );
    }
}
